blocks.text: The manager of United States country music legend Dolly Parton dropped a civil lawsuit against the singer’s nephew on Thursday, Nov. 5, US media reported, after a row enveloped the late musician’s estate. The lawsuit filed in September by Parton’s longtime manager Danny Nozell accused her nephew, Bryan Seaver, of attempting to extort money from the estate, which includes an amusement park, a hotel and a soon-to-be-opened museum.
